text: 位于白俄罗斯明斯克郊区的中白工业园GREATPORT多式联运铁路场站6日正式开业投运，首列“麦穗”号和“矢车菊”号中欧集装箱班列从场站发往中国。GREATPORT是现代化物流综合体，该项目由中白工业园居民企业亚欧陆运通道股份有限公司投资运营，具备集装箱班列集结、发运和接收能力，可处理进出口及过境等货流任务。场站设计年吞吐量为18万标箱，未来计划提升至50万标箱。项目已建成4条铁路线及系列配套功能设施。（新华社）
text_en: The GREATPORT multimodal railway terminal in the China-Belarus Great Stone Industrial Park on the outskirts of Minsk, Belarus, officially opened and began operations on the 6th, with the first China-Europe container trains, the "Wheat Ear" and the "Cornflower," departing from the terminal for China. GREATPORT is a modern logistics complex invested in and operated by Eurasia Land Transport Corridor Co., Ltd., a resident enterprise of the industrial park. It has the capacity to assemble, dispatch and receive container trains and can handle import, export and transit cargo flows. The terminal is designed with an annual throughput of 180,000 TEUs, with plans to raise it to 500,000 TEUs in the future. The project has completed four railway lines and a series of supporting facilities. (Xinhua News Agency)
